state: Project Aegis Play Mode UAT, 2026-11-21, after rounds 1-4. Game: Unity 6.3 C2 (command and control) naval sim over a deterministic headless C# sim. Evidence: headless suite 4,620 passed / 0 failed; Phase 0 CI smoke PASS; Unity PlayMode tests 18/20 (1 failure from an uncommitted local test edit, 1 SliceA contact-panel test whose expectation predates this branch); 0 console errors in all 5 baltic-patrol scenarios; shipped catalog DB hashes unchanged after Play Mode and the full suite; zero-touch DelegationBridge.cs unchanged; replay goldens unchanged. Every reachable UI control was exercised by code (210 controls, 34 panels): fixed defects D12, D17, D19-D25, D27, D29-D31, CLI-1, CLI-5 each with a test; layout fixes verified by screenshot. Red-first evidence is partial for D20 (no test possible), D21/D23/D25 (compile-only red), D24 (red not observed). OPEN DECISIONS: D15/D18: about 27 UI panel hosts exist in code but in no scene; the scene builder can add 17 of them, but adding all at once stacks full-screen panels over the map; 10 hosts (including both in-game editor shells: Scenario Editor and Platform Editor) are in no scene, prefab or builder. D26: the in-game Scenario Editor shell's Load/Save/Undo/Redo/Play/Sample buttons raise events nothing subscribes to; the shell text says it will be bound in a later wave; a separate Editor-window Scenario Map Authoring tool works fully. D24b: unit and contact selection are exclusive by design (an earlier QA fix), yet the contact panel says 'select a friendly unit for range assessment', which can never happen; Unit Detail shows 'ENGAGE READY' while Contact Detail says 'technical targetability NO'. D35: no Addressables settings are committed although the APP-6 symbol atlas is documented as Addressables-loaded; a menu item regenerates settings per machine; the game currently loads the atlas via a direct USS url. D22 behaviour change: default unit selection now skips red (enemy) units, so the player starts with their own unit selected instead of the alphabetically-first enemy. D28: the 'Play Baltic Escort' menu item rebuilds and saves the committed scene each run with new file IDs (git noise, same content). D16: repeated policy denials lower the player score (game-design question). CLI-2..CLI-13: 11 Mission Editor CLI input-validation/exit-code defects (S3-S4), e.g. invalid enum values accepted, missing files exit 2 instead of 1, read-only verbs create a DB file for a missing path. D33: SliceA test expects 'UNKNOWN' source but gets the real source; likely pre-existing on main. Local catalog DB modifications backed up outside the repo were shown to be test pollution (defect D19). Owner C10 pixel sign-off pending. Rubric rule: a failed mechanical check is never rescued by a high score.

d15_d18.instructions: What should be done about UI panel hosts that exist in code but in no scene?

criteria.add_all_builder_hosts: Regenerate the scene with all builder hosts now and fix overlaps afterwards
criteria.keep_minimal_document: Keep the minimal scene; document the unreachable hosts as backlog

d26.instructions: What should happen to the in-game Scenario Editor shell whose action buttons are unwired?

criteria.disable_with_reason: Keep it out of scenes and make the unwired buttons show a clear 'not yet available' reason
criteria.wire_load_save_now: Wire Load and Save to the existing authoring session now
criteria.leave_unchanged: Leave as is until the later wave

d24b.instructions: How should the contradiction between exclusive selection and the contact panel's range-assessment hint be resolved?

criteria.use_last_friendly_for_assessment: Keep exclusive selection but compute range assessment from the last selected friendly unit, and fix the hint text
criteria.change_hint_text_only: Keep behaviour; change the hint to say range assessment is shown on the unit panel
criteria.allow_dual_selection: Allow a friendly shooter and a contact to be selected at the same time

d35.instructions: What should be done about the missing committed Addressables settings?

criteria.commit_generated_settings: Commit the generated Addressables settings so every machine matches
criteria.document_direct_load: Document that the atlas loads via USS url and mark the Addressables menu item as optional

d22_default_skips_red.instructions: Should the default unit selection skip enemy (red) units so the player starts with their own unit selected?

d28.instructions: How should the 'Play Baltic Escort' scene-rewrite noise be handled?

criteria.play_without_rebuild: Make Play open and play the committed scene, and rebuild only from the explicit Build menu item

cli_defects.instructions: What should happen to the 11 open Mission Editor CLI validation/exit-code defects?
